verdict.rationale: OpenTofu supports review via `tofu plan` speculative plans and version control of infrastructure-as-code (docs-3, docs-4, docs-16), plus module/version pinning for consistency (docs-12) and state encryption for safe storage (docs-9). However there is no explicit rollback mechanism or documented workflow (e.g., a 'rollback' command or state-versioning restore process) beyond implied git-based reversion. missing for 10: explicit rollback/state-restore documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of rollback workflows.
